titleTr: Yoğun bir gün: ago, last, yesterday ve sıralama

grammar.topic: Geçmiş zaman ifadeleri (ago, last, yesterday) ve first / then / after that / finally
explainTr: 'Ago' geçmişte ne kadar önce olduğunu söyler ve süreden sonra gelir: two days ago, five years ago. 'Last' + zaman kendi başına kullanılır: last night, last week, last year. 'Yesterday' dün demektir: yesterday morning, yesterday afternoon.
Dikkat: 'last morning' veya 'yesterday week' denmez. Sabah, öğleden sonra, akşam için yesterday kullan: yesterday evening. Gece için last night denir (yesterday night değil).
Olayları sırayla anlatmak için: First (önce), Then (sonra), After that (ondan sonra), Finally (en sonunda). Her biri cümlenin başına gelir ve virgül alabilir: First, I made breakfast.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'iki gün önce' süre başta gelir. İngilizcede 'ago' sondadır: 'two days ago'. 'Önce' kelimesi 'before' ile karışır; geçmişteki bir süreyi 'ago' ile söyleriz: I moved here two years ago, 'before two years' demeyiz.

examples.en: I moved here two years ago.
Yesterday morning I went to the bank.
First, I made tea. Then I called the school.
examples.tr: Önce çay yaptım. Sonra okulu aradım.

examples.en: Finally, I got home at five.
examples.tr: En sonunda saat beşte eve geldim.

exercises.q: I called the school two days ___.
exercises.whyTr: Süreden sonra 'ago' gelir: two days ago.

exercises.q: Hafsa went to the market ___ Friday.
exercises.whyTr: Gün adından önce 'last' kullanılır: last Friday.

exercises.q: Hafsa was at the bank ___ morning.
___ I made breakfast. Then I took the bus.
She finished work. ___ that, she went to the store.

exercises.answer: I moved here three years ago
exercises.whyTr: 'Ago' süreden sonra ve cümlenin sonunda gelir.

options: I saw Linda ago three days.
I saw Linda before three days.
I saw Linda three days ago.

exercises.q: Hafsa made tea. ___ she took the bus.
___ you go to the market yesterday?
exercises.whyTr: Önceki konu: geçmişte soru 'Did' ile başlar.

exercises.q: ___ I called the school. Then I took the bus.

reading.title: Hafsa's very busy Tuesday
reading.text:
Yesterday was the busiest day of the month for Hafsa. First, she made breakfast for Emre and walked him to the bus stop. Then she went to the bakery and bought bread. After that, she hurried to the front office at Lincoln Elementary because Mr. Brown left a message the day before.

At ten o'clock Mr. Brown gave her a form. She finished it, and he said, "Come back on Friday." Then Hafsa ran some errands. She returned a book to the library and paid a bill at the bank. Suddenly it started to rain, and the traffic was terrible. The bus was twenty minutes late.

Finally, she got home at five o'clock. She forgot to buy milk, but she remembered Emre's soccer practice. She made dinner for both of them. By nine o'clock she was exhausted. In her notebook she wrote, "Today was busy, but I did everything."

questions.q: What did Hafsa buy at the bakery?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'she went to the bakery and bought bread'.

questions.q: Why was Hafsa late at the end of the day?
options: The bus was late because of the rain and traffic.
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'it started to rain, and the traffic was terrible. The bus was twenty minutes late.'

questions.q: How did Hafsa feel at nine o'clock?
questions.whyTr: Metin: 'By nine o'clock she was exhausted'.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Hafsa, I called you yesterday. Where were you?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Oh, I'm sorry, Linda. It was a crazy day.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: First, I made breakfast and took Emre to the bus stop. Then I went to the school office.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: After that, I returned a library book and bought bread at the bakery.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes! Then it rained, and the bus was late. I got home at five o'clock.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, but I forgot to buy milk.

script.speaker: Hafsa

questions.q: What did Hafsa do first yesterday?
What time did Hafsa get home?
questions.whyTr: Hafsa: 'I got home at five o'clock'.

questions.q: What did Hafsa forget to buy?

writing.promptTr: Yoğun bir günü 5-6 cümleyle anlat. First, Then, After that ve Finally kullan.
writing.promptEn: Write about a busy day. Use First, Then, After that and Finally.
writing.model: Yesterday was a busy day. First, I made breakfast. Then I went to the bakery. After that, I returned a book to the library. Finally, I cooked dinner. I forgot milk, but Linda helped me. I was exhausted, but I was happy.
checklistTr: First, Then, After that, Finally kullandın mı?
Geçmiş fiilleri doğru yazdın mı (went, returned, cooked)?
Cümleler büyük harfle başlıyor ve noktayla bitiyor mu?

examSet.q: I came to this country five years ___.
Emre went to the library ___ Saturday.
___ I made lunch. Then I washed the dishes.
Hafsa cleaned the house. After ___, she took a shower.
The bus was late because of the ___.
I need to buy milk and mail a letter. I have many ___ today.
Which word means almost the same as "finally"?
examSet.whyTr: Finally ve at last benzer anlamlı.
Önceki konu: geçmişte soru 'Did' ile başlar.
Önceki konu: geçmişte olumsuz didn't + yalın fiil.

examSet.q:
Last night Hafsa studied English for two hours. First, she read a short story. Then she wrote ten new words in her notebook. After that, she listened to a song. Finally, she went to bed.

What did she do after she wrote the new words?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'After that, she listened to a song'.

examSet.q:
Emre had a hard morning. He forgot his lunch at home. He ran back, but the bus left. Suddenly Ms. Carter stopped her car and took him to school.

Who took Emre to school?
examSet.whyTr: Metin: 'Ms. Carter stopped her car and took him to school'.
